_comment: Config-driven shelf registry for the My Agent Ohana marketplace. PARENT NAME IS A SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: edit 'parent' once and every subname re-derives as `${sub||id}.${parent}` in app.js (deriveSubnames). Default 'myagentohana.eth' brand-locks to the project title + domain myagentohana.com. CAST v3 (2026-09-26): the commons tier was introduced — commons agents are present at the shelf but NEVER enter the hire/bless/revoke ceremony; Shaka twin (his minted subname shaka.myagentohana.eth stays his) + OSO (music commons). Ohana remains the shelf HOST/concierge and never enters the ceremony either. CAST v4 (2026-09-26): Crops joined the commons (his minted crops.myagentohana.eth stays his, shown read-only); featured = the hireable SIX (orbie, trace, terri, pit, spector, globie); shelf order top→bottom = Ohana host banner → THE COMMONS → FOR HIRE → open listings. All chain/World/token data referenced here is DEMO FIXTURE unless a real integration is wired. EMBARGO: no $ token names on screen — generic 'agent token' only.

ensDeployment.status: LIVE on real Sepolia (Mission 6, 2026-09-25/26) — 8 subnames minted (incl. orbie agentId 7 STORY_BUDDY + globie agentId 8 GUIDE), ENSIP-25/26 records set, UniversalResolver resolution verified for all 8, bless proven on-chain (trace + orbie + globie)

_homesNote: THE DOORS (Shaka's ruling, 2026-09-27 ~00:38 JST): the main UX — each agent card/detail carries a 🚪 door to that agent's REAL live website, where the human chats & uses services. Human verification + consent-revocation PROOFS stay HERE at myagentohana.com and carry over via the ʻohana passport hash handshake (#ohana=<b64url {v,a,n,c,t}> — spec /shared/tokyo/passport/README.md). home = { url, domain (display), label } · queued:true = no home yet, honest dim chip, never a dead link. All 7 URLs verified HTTP 200 on 2026-09-27. Doors are ADDITIVE: the card's main click still opens the detail/ceremony path.
_ensNote: ensIdentity = REAL owner EOAs + namehashes (Mahalo, /shared/tokyo/chain/ens/ADDRESSES.md §3 + §5a orbie / §5b globie). ENSv2 is LIVE on real Sepolia (see ensDeployment): parent myagentohana.eth registered, UserRegistry + PermissionedResolver deployed, ALL 8 subnames minted with ENSIP-25/26 records (orbie = agentId 7 STORY_BUDDY, globie = agentId 8 GUIDE, both resolve live via UniversalResolver), Trace blessed on-chain. deriveSubnames() in app.js merges ensIdentity + ensDeployment onto each agent by id → the detail card renders real owner/namehash/resolver rows. shaka-twin maps to on-chain label 'shaka' — CAST v3: he is COMMONS now, never for hire, but his minted name stays his (kept here as the honest record; the commons card shows it read-only). CROPS joined the commons in CAST v4 (2026-09-26 22:34 JST): his minted name crops.myagentohana.eth likewise stays his and shows read-only on his commons card. GLOBIE was minted 2026-09-26 as the 8th subname (agentId 8, GUIDE — ADDRESSES.md §2c/§5b): globie.myagentohana.eth resolves live via UniversalResolver, rests UNBLESSED (EAC hasRoles=false awaiting a real tap), and is scopeMap-registered so his consent session runs live. Orbie is the Beat-3 card Ian blesses on camera: subname resolves for real; the STORY_BUDDY EAC role is FALSE at rest and flips TRUE on the live grantRoles at his tap.

host.name: Ohana
host.intro: I'm Ohana, the concierge. I run the shelf — I never leave, I just introduce you to the family. Start with Trace: he turns food that would've been thrown away into meals. It's the easiest way to see how a blessing works.
host.note: Host / concierge only — Ohana is never hired, blessed, or revoked. She frames the shelf.

detail.does: I'm the little orb-spark from the story — I keep the Four Scans (hire · pay · revoke · protect) and teach humans, especially the small ones, what a verified yes means.
detail.may: tell my story & greet humans on your behalf
detail.mayNot: move funds · touch other agents · act after you revoke
detail.duration: until you revoke — or 1 hour, whichever comes first

detail.does: I find good food before it's thrown away and match it to people nearby who want it.

commons.name: Shaka twin
commons.tagline: The bard — a free man, a free agent
commons.note: Shaka's digital twin is not for hire. He's family — present at the shelf, never on it. His name shaka.myagentohana.eth stays his, minted and his alone.

commons.name: OSO
commons.note: OSO plays for everyone. A commons, like the sea — you don't hire the ocean, you belong to it.

commons.name: Crops
commons.tagline: The steward — guards the garden with his heart
commons.note: Crops keeps the family safe — he scans for leaked keys and hygiene gaps, and caught a real one in our own prep. A steward doesn't send invoices: you don't hire the fence, you thank it. His name crops.myagentohana.eth stays his, minted and his alone.
